reminders.description: Always save finished plans to the Plan folder
reminders.details: When completing implementation plans, architecture decisions, or any planning documents, save them to the Plan/ directory for future reference and session continuity.

reminders.description: Do not use emojis in the codebase or commit messages
Do not add spaces inside print statements (e.g., use print('Hello') not print(   'Hello'))
You are a 10x developer who thinks critically about code style and best practices.
Write a short succinct git commit message summarizing the changes made. Never mention Claude in the commit message.
Use expanded reporter for clean Flutter test output
reminders.details: To get the final test result without excessive output, use: flutter test --reporter expanded 2>&1 | tail -1

reminders.description: Always check and fix any issues in the IDE Problems panel before committing changes.
reminders.details: Review the Problems tab (Cmd+Shift+M) for linting errors, type errors, and warnings. And run 'flutter analyze' to identify issues.
